ladder: Beef > Japanese Wagyu (by prefecture) > American & Australian Wagyu > Poultry > Seafood > Pork (by breed) > Game & Specialty > Sides & Pantry
facets: species and programme; wagyu origin; pork breed; pasture-raised; grass-fed; organic
quality_markers: breed; feeding (pasture, grass-fed); origin prefecture; grade (A5/BMS)
quality_signals: A5 and BMS wagyu grades; Heritage, Ibérico, Mangalitsa pork breeds
notes: Species-led top level; wagyu gets own sections by origin; breed labels for pork; no filter list seen.

ladder: Fleisch Wurst und Ersatz > Wurst > product type (Würste, Salami, Geflügelwurst, Roher Schinken, Schinken, Speck, Leberwurst, Mettwurst ...)
facets: Produkteigenschaften (Bio; Vegan; Fair; Vegetarisch; Glutenfrei; Laktosefrei); Produktkategorie; Hersteller; Sortierung (Kalorien; Preis; alphabetisch)
notes: Third-party mirror of REWE tree. About 89 named product types, many regional (Weißwurst, Lyoner, Landjäger); brand is a filter not a level.

ladder: Grade (Select > Choice > Prime) > cut (ribeye, T-bone, porterhouse)
quality_markers: marbling; animal age (maturity); grade then cut; taste and budget
quality_signals: USDA Prime; USDA Choice; USDA Select
notes: Warns wagyu label does not mean top grade; Prime often only at specialty counters.

quality_signals: USDA grade shield (voluntary, paid, set by USDA); JMGA for wagyu
notes: Grading is voluntary; the shield on label; Prime ~2-3% and Choice most common per other guides.

source_name: Crowd Cow wagyu grading guide (JP system)
ladder: Yield letter A-C > quality number 1-5 > BMS 1-12
quality_markers: marbling (BMS); meat colour and brightness; firmness and texture; fat colour and quality (lowest of four sets the grade)
quality_signals: JMGA grade A5/A4/A3; BMS 1-12; A5 = BMS 8-12
notes: Japan Meat Grading Association grades each carcass; quality number is lowest of four sub-scores, not an average.

source_name: Reluctant Gourmet jamon iberico de bellota guide (ES)
quality_markers: breed; diet (acorns); time (aged 36 months or more); origin (dehesa regions Jabugo, Guijuelo, Los Pedroches)
quality_signals: Ibérico colour labels (black 100% Ibérico bellota; red; green cebo de campo; white cebo); pata negra not official
notes: Spanish ham sold by colour label combining breed, feeding and cure; no body named on page.
